decisions.reason: The exposure-band mapping does not alter report-identifier requirements; the distinct identifier corrections in the same message are already represented by a complete MODIFY.
Exposure-band labels do not change footer presentation or identifiers; the same message's separate footer corrections are already represented.
The corrected exposure-band mapping does not change header style or identifier rules; the separate header corrections are already represented.
Correcting content assigned to existing report variants does not change the required editable variants, source formats, or PDF-export capability.

The dashboard still must display the risk band and exposure level; their variant-specific values are owned by the exposure-mapping Requirement and do not change the dashboard's presentation requirement.
Changing exposure labels for report variants does not alter which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The exposure-band correction has no effect on the required fonts, icons, design assets, or handoff purpose.
The exposure-band mapping does not change the required concise explanation format or the listed security weaknesses.
Correcting variant-specific exposure terminology does not change the accepted visual style or refinement priorities.
The exposure-band mapping is unrelated to the final-page confidentiality warning's presence, clarity, visual treatment, or footer interaction.
